comment: Identities of piano's own gen80000 GPU firmware (stock OS3.0.303.0.WPYCNXM vendor_a and odm_a). Not the firmware: tooling/k27/build-native-piano-a830.sh copies the files from PIANO_GPU_FW (default ../xiaomipad-8pro-mainline/firmware, pinned there by piano-gpu.json) into the ignored out/native-kexts/PianoA830/firmware after checking these pins, and embeds them from there. Same layout as UniXNU-Pagani_SM8750 scripts/data/sm8750-gpu-inputs.json 'firmware', so Adreno830's tests/run-host-tests.py --pins reads it.
